arguments.sql: SELECT AVG(amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS avg_amount_usd FROM transactions WHERE amount_usd_cents > 0
arguments.explanation: Returns the average transaction amount in dollars, counting only transactions with a positive amount across all transactions, labelled or not.
assumptions: Covers all transactions in the database (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), whether or not they carry a fraud label.
Positive means amount_usd_cents > 0; zero and negative amounts are excluded.
